For those of my fellow goats who used to smoke weed on a regular basis, what do you miss about it? What do you not miss, or rather, what have you gained from regular weed-free living?

I used to smoke a lot. Usually two or three times a day. I gave it up so I could get a job that paid better, and I don't really regret it, but I do miss being able to toke up after a hard day. I also didn't drink as much alcohol, and I definitely wasn't as sore then as I am now. I thought initially that was because my job then wasn't as difficult as my job now is, but I don't really think that's the case. I lift about the same amount of weight with the same frequency, I walk about the same amount I did before.

I suppose I miss pot because it put all my daily aches and pains on the back burner. I'm sure I was still sore and achy, but it was never as prevalent in my mind as it is now. I also miss how much easier it was to simply shrug my shoulders and say "Eh, fuck it, that's just the way it is." I worried a lot less when I was on pot. Overall, my quality of life hasn't changed all that much. I make more money, sure, but not that much more. It's literally been the difference between barely making my ends meet, and being able to cover all my bills while having a very small amount left over to save up. It's been about a year now, and what I've noticed is that I get irritated by stupid shit much more easily. I'm less willing and able to tolerate general human stupidity, and encountering people who are assholes tends to bring out my inner asshole much more brutally than it used to. It's harder to empathize with people now, because I find myself not giving a fuck about anyone's problems by my own. When someone I know gripes about their life, in my head I'm just tallying up all the ways in which my life seems a bit more sucky, and it's never a lot, but I didn't really do that when I was getting high. I was a lot more compassionate then than I am now. I guess that kinda bugs me.

I suppose I really miss how calm it made me. Sitting down and smoking a bowl really let me take a longview of things, where I would mull shit over and figure things out. Now it's all just frantic panic and anxiety.

What I gained seems kinda limited in comparison. Yeah, I'm clear headed, but I worry a hell of a lot more about things that I really don't have any control over. I gained more money from a better job, but I'm never home, I never see my friends, because when they're awake I'm asleep and when I'm awake, they're asleep or at jobs of their own. Cleaning the house never seemed like a big deal, but now the chores pile up because I'm never around to do them, and after a ten hour shift, I don't WANT to fucking do them.

The best thing that's come of stopping my pot use? I dream again, When I sleep, my dreams come alive. And they're fucking crazy. They feel like scenes from other lives. They're not surreal or abstract, but rather they feel like I'm living out a past or future or alternate existence that I can't really make heads or tails of. Shit, in one dream I stole a fucking tank. I don't even know why! I stole a tank and I ran over the three soldiers guarding it (Not Modern, US Soldiers, weirdly enough, but like, 1960's-80's soldiers whose uniforms I didn't recognize), then I took the fucker on a joy ride in what looked like the rural backroads of any state in Midwest USA. I never used to have such vivid dreams when I was on pot, but I have them on an almost nightly basis now. Sometimes there are monsters in the dreams, but I'm never so afraid that I'd call them nightmares...more like, the monsters are there, and it's just one more thing that my dreamself needs to overcome to keep the story rolling.

Anyway, back to the original question: What are your thoughts, my fellow crazy people?
